'''Exoboar soup''' was a type of soup that featured [[exoboar]], a creature from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. [[Jaesa Willsaam]] once tried exoboar soup, and became violently ill as a result.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1stm}}
